description: This file defines the FFmpegCaptureService class for capturing PCM16 audio using FFmpeg, including energy calculation, process management, and event handling for streaming audio data to a WebSocket or API.

classes.name: FFmpegCaptureService
classes.description: A class that manages FFmpeg process to capture PCM16 audio, emit audio data and energy levels, and handle process lifecycle.

methods.name: calculateFrameEnergy
methods.description: Calculates RMS energy of PCM16 audio frame, normalized between 0 and 1.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the FFmpeg process to capture audio, emits 'audioData' and 'audioEnergy' events.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the audio capture process gracefully.

methods.name: getCaptureDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration in milliseconds since capture started.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Returns whether the capture process is active.

methods.name: buildFFmpegArgs
methods.description: Builds command-line arguments for FFmpeg based on platform and device.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up process resources and emits 'stopped'.
